test_message_deduplicator_ttl: test the MessageDeduplicator class TTL enforcement to verify expired entries are not treated as duplicates
test_message_deduplicator_is_duplicate: test the MessageDeduplicator.is_duplicate method to verify duplicate detection within and beyond the TTL window
test_message_deduplicator_max_size_evict: test the MessageDeduplicator max_size eviction behavior to verify expired entries are pruned on cache overflow
test_message_deduplicator_different_mess: test the MessageDeduplicator class to verify different message IDs are tracked independently
test_message_deduplicator_ttl_zero: test the MessageDeduplicator with TTL=0 to verify deduplication is effectively disabled
